live_proof.final_observed: JM Closure & Handoff live proof PASS: execution CLOSED -> ordered closure -> synthetic Ding containment/retest -> recovery pointer -> handoff -> FORWARD_READY; router did not retroactively manufacture product/contact/crown proof.

non_claims: The live CI fixture does not freeze, lock, anchor or mount a real product; those PASS values are synthetic route-state evidence for the router test.
The synthetic recovery pointer is not a real keeper pointer and is not published as one.
FORWARD_READY does not create a descendant automatically; it means the closure/handoff route no longer blocks forward creation.
Execution CLOSED remains distinct from closure completion.
Closure completion remains distinct from runtime/contact/crown proof.
proof_result: PASS — EXECUTION CLOSED -> ORDERED APPLICABLE CLOSURE -> FAIL-CLOSED DING -> LOCAL RETEST -> RECOVERY POINTER -> HANDOFF -> FORWARD_READY
governing_result: The JM default now governs entry, execution and closure as separate evidence-bounded bodies. Packaging may be N/A when genuinely inapplicable; freeze/lock/anchor/mount cannot be inferred from CLOSED; forward creation is unlocked only after closure continuity and recovery routing are resolved.
